erasure_requests_completion_check.name: erasure_requests_completion_check
erasure_requests_completion_check.value: ("erasure_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "erasure_requests"."local_completed_at" is null and "erasure_requests"."completed_at" is null) or ("erasure_requests"."status" = 'local_completed' and "erasure_requests"."local_completed_at" is not null and "erasure_requests"."completed_at" is null) or ("erasure_requests"."status" = 'completed' and "erasure_requests"."local_completed_at" is not null and "erasure_requests"."completed_at" is not null) or ("erasure_requests"."status" = 'failed' and "erasure_requests"."completed_at" is null)

erasure_requests_timestamps_check.name: erasure_requests_timestamps_check
erasure_requests_timestamps_check.value: ("erasure_requests"."local_completed_at" is null or "erasure_requests"."local_completed_at" >= "erasure_requests"."created_at") and ("erasure_requests"."completed_at" is null or ("erasure_requests"."local_completed_at" is not null and "erasure_requests"."completed_at" >= "erasure_requests"."local_completed_at"))

fact_find_sessions_completed_at_check.name: fact_find_sessions_completed_at_check
fact_find_sessions_completed_at_check.value: ("fact_find_sessions"."status" = 'started' and "fact_find_sessions"."completed_at" is null) or ("fact_find_sessions"."status" <> 'started' and "fact_find_sessions"."completed_at" is not null)

metric_daily_runs_completed_at_check.name: metric_daily_runs_completed_at_check
metric_daily_runs_completed_at_check.value: ("metric_daily_runs"."status" = 'running' and "metric_daily_runs"."completed_at" is null) or ("metric_daily_runs"."status" <> 'running' and "metric_daily_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

module_versions_published_at_check.name: module_versions_published_at_check
module_versions_published_at_check.value: ("module_versions"."status" = 'draft' and "module_versions"."published_at" is null) or ("module_versions"."status" in ('published', 'retired') and "module_versions"."published_at" is not null)

partner_export_batches_ready_at_check.name: partner_export_batches_ready_at_check
partner_export_batches_ready_at_check.value: ("partner_export_batches"."status" = 'ready' and "partner_export_batches"."ready_at" is not null) or ("partner_export_batches"."status" <> 'ready' and "partner_export_batches"."ready_at" is null)

privacy_deletion_outbox_subject_key_vers.name: privacy_deletion_outbox_subject_key_versions_check
privacy_deletion_outbox_subject_key_vers.value: cardinality("privacy_deletion_outbox"."external_subject_key_versions") = cardinality("privacy_deletion_outbox"."external_subject_ids") and array_position("privacy_deletion_outbox"."external_subject_key_versions", null) is null and (cardinality("privacy_deletion_outbox"."external_subject_key_versions") = 0 or 0 < all("privacy_deletion_outbox"."external_subject_key_versions"))

privacy_deletion_outbox_processed_check.name: privacy_deletion_outbox_processed_check
privacy_deletion_outbox_processed_check.value: ("privacy_deletion_outbox"."processed_at" is null) or ("privacy_deletion_outbox"."processed_at" >= "privacy_deletion_outbox"."created_at" and "privacy_deletion_outbox"."last_failure_code" is null)

provider_usage_nonnegative_check.name: provider_usage_nonnegative_check
provider_usage_nonnegative_check.value: "provider_usage"."input_tokens" >= 0 and "provider_usage"."output_tokens" >= 0 and "provider_usage"."cached_input_tokens" >= 0 and "provider_usage"."audio_input_ms" >= 0 and "provider_usage"."audio_output_ms" >= 0 and "provider_usage"."cost_micros" >= 0 and "provider_usage"."latency_ms" >= 0

provider_usage_outbox_processed_check.name: provider_usage_outbox_processed_check
provider_usage_outbox_processed_check.value: ("provider_usage_outbox"."processed_at" is null) or ("provider_usage_outbox"."processed_at" is not null and "provider_usage_outbox"."langfuse_delivered_at" is not null)

telemetry_outbox_processed_check.name: telemetry_outbox_processed_check
telemetry_outbox_processed_check.value: ("telemetry_outbox"."processed_at" is null and "telemetry_outbox"."suppressed_at" is null and ("telemetry_outbox"."posthog_delivered_at" is null or "telemetry_outbox"."otel_delivered_at" is null)) or ("telemetry_outbox"."processed_at" is not null and ("telemetry_outbox"."suppressed_at" is not null or ("telemetry_outbox"."posthog_delivered_at" is not null and "telemetry_outbox"."otel_delivered_at" is not null)))

telemetry_outbox_suppression_check.name: telemetry_outbox_suppression_check
telemetry_outbox_suppression_check.value: ("telemetry_outbox"."suppressed_at" is null and "telemetry_outbox"."suppression_reason" is null) or ("telemetry_outbox"."suppressed_at" is not null and "telemetry_outbox"."suppression_reason" in ('consent_not_granted', 'withdrawn', 'unclassified_event', 'purpose_limited'))
